title: Project generator
objective: create-project command: copies the app skeleton, initialises ai-project-template protocol via ai-init --target, selects profile/modules, writes architecture block and confirmed validation commands, inherits ADRs, git init, validation, optional dev start. Interactive and non-interactive. Supports identity profiles (--auth basic|consumer|b2b|enterprise, --organizations, --admin, --cedar) with full auth/admin/account foundation on by default unless opted out.
acceptance_criteria: create-project demo --profile core --no-start produces a project whose ./dev check passes
create-project app --auth b2b --admin yields organizations + admin enabled in project.json architecture and passing auth/tenancy tests
validation: python3 -m unittest scripts tests for generator
